summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. filed a 6-K containing Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Returns and a Monthly Return covering ongoing share repurchases. The company repurchased American depositary shares on multiple dates in August 2026 at prices between USD 21.32 and USD 23.00 per ADS, each ADS representing one Class A ordinary share. These buybacks are being conducted under the company's existing share repurchase program. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium was stated. The filing is a routine disclosure of capital returns activity. What to watch: continued buyback pace and any change to authorized repurchase limits.
